as_of_content:
'''Bleed''' is a damaging debuff ability that drains an opponent's health over time for several seconds. The other damaging debuffs are [[Shock]], [[Burn]], and [[Acid]].
== Bots with Bleed ==
*[[Arcee]] (Headshot)
*[[Bonecrusher]]
*[[Bludgeon]]
*[[Cheetor]] (Melee Crit hits and Special Attack 1)
*[[Dinobot]] (Critical Heavy Attacks)
*[[Drift]]
*[[Hound]] (Special Attack 2 & 3)
*[[Kickback]] (Special Attack 2)
*[[Necrotronus]] (20 or more Titan Charges)
*[[Optimus Primal]] (Special Attack 1 and 2)
*[[Optimus Prime]] (Breach signature ability on critical attacks on [[Armor Break]])
*[[Optimus Prime (MV1)]] (Special Attacks)
*[[Rhinox]]
*[[Scorponok]]
*[[Windblade]]

== Mods ==
* [[Harm Accelerator]]
[[Category:Abilities]]
